lines.zh: 嘶嘶作响，如同深渊的低吟。
lines.en: Sssssss, a deep whisper from the abyss.

lines.zh: 铁甲划过石地，发出铿锵之声。
lines.en: Iron plates scrape the stone, making a clashing sound.

lines.zh: 身体缓缓移动，仿佛吞噬一切的阴影。
lines.en: The body moves slowly, like a shadow devouring everything.

lines.zh: 发出雷鸣般的脚步声，震动大地。
lines.en: Roaring footsteps shake the ground.

lines.zh: 金属甲壳摩擦，发出刺耳声响。
lines.en: Metallic shells scrape together, producing a harsh sound.

lines.zh: 铁制触角轻轻触碰地面。
lines.en: Iron antennae lightly touch the ground.

lines.zh: 缓慢爬行，留下一串铁锈印记。
lines.en: Slowly crawling, leaving iron rust marks.

lines.zh: 厚重的步伐声回荡在山谷。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps echo in the valley.

lines.zh: 铁甲拖地声，如同死亡的序曲。
lines.en: Iron armor dragging on the ground, like a death symphony.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声，带着毁灭的气息。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps, carrying the scent of destruction.

lines.zh: 双眼空洞，目光如同深渊。
lines.en: Empty eyes, gaze like an abyss.

lines.zh: 铁甲反射出昏暗的光芒。
lines.en: Iron armor reflecting dim light.

lines.zh: 铁爪轻轻摩擦，发出轻微声响。
lines.en: Iron claws lightly rubbing, producing a soft sound.
Metallic body leaning lazily.

lines.zh: 铁甲上的锈迹慢慢显现。
lines.en: Rust on the iron armor slowly appears.

lines.zh: 金属表面闪烁着微弱的光芒。
lines.en: Metal surface emitting faint light.

lines.zh: 机械般僵硬的动作，仿佛生锈。
lines.en: Mechanical and stiff movements, as if rusted.

lines.zh: 铁制肢体懒洋洋地摇晃。
lines.en: Iron limbs lazily swaying.

lines.zh: 目光空洞，仿佛看透一切。
lines.en: Empty gaze, as if seeing through everything.
Metallic body slowly writhing.
Rusty water drips down my iron plates.
I listen to the echoes in the stone cracks.
The smell of rust keeps thickening.
I wait for someone to walk into reach.
The gears in my joints turn slowly.
This iron shell sits heavy and sure.
Targeting the player, iron claws tensed.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中闪烁绿光。
lines.en: Staring at the player, green light flickering in eyes.

lines.zh: 铁甲中露出獠牙，威胁玩家。
lines.en: Tusks in the iron armor, threatening the player.
Locking on the player, iron claws gripping.
Iron armor flashing, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 目光聚焦玩家，铁爪收紧。
lines.en: Eyes focusing on the player, iron claws tightening.
Targeting the player, iron armor trembling.

lines.zh: 铁甲中闪现绿色光芒，锁定目标。
lines.en: Green light flashing in the iron armor, locking onto the target.

lines.zh: 盯紧玩家，铁爪蓄势待发。
lines.en: Staring at the player, iron claws ready to strike.
Iron claws curling, ready to attack.
Green light sweeps across your armor.
I have measured the distance to pull you.

lines.zh: 震颤着，我感受到死亡的冰凉触感...
lines.en: Shaking, I feel the cold touch of death...
My body is torn...

lines.zh: 我感到虚弱，但我不会倒下...
lines.en: I feel weak, but I won't fall...
This is... the final battle...
Pain... pain... pain...
I was knocked down...
I will hold on until victory...

lines.zh: 每一声呼喊都让我更接近死亡...
lines.en: Each cry brings me closer to death...
I won't let you win...
Strength... gone...

lines.zh: 你身上的光泽吸引着我
lines.en: Your shine tempts me.
Stay away from my domain.
I will devour your strength.
My presence is destruction.
I am irresistible.
Your end is near.
Feel my power.
This is my territory.
Don't let my power fade.
My power cannot be matched.
Feel my pull.
You will be devoured.
Stay away from me.
Feel my power.
You cannot escape.
My power is everywhere.
You will regret your approach.
I will not easily forgive.
Your power is useless to me.
You cannot defeat me.
Find my mate.
I will protect my mate.

lines.zh: 只有我配得上我的伴侣
lines.en: Only I am worthy of my mate.

lines.zh: 两副铁壳，撞在一起才像家。
lines.en: Two iron shells knocking together feel like home.
We fight together.
My mate is important.
We are one.
I will protect my home.
We are inseparable.
My mate is everything to me.

lines.zh: 它张开巨大颚，露出锋利的牙齿。
lines.en: It opens its huge mouth, revealing sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 它那双邪恶的眼睛盯着你。
lines.en: Its evil eyes stare at you.

lines.zh: 它的皮肤如同岩石般坚硬。
lines.en: Its skin is as hard as rock.

lines.zh: 铁颚一张，吼声震落石屑。
lines.en: My iron jaw opens; the roar shakes loose stone.

lines.zh: 你感受到它的气息中带着死亡。
lines.en: You feel the death in its breath.

lines.zh: 它的体型庞大，如同山岳般。
lines.en: It's massive, like a mountain.

lines.zh: 它的爪子如同利剑般锐利。
lines.en: Its claws are like sharp swords.

lines.zh: 它开始咀嚼周围的石块。
lines.en: It starts chewing on the rocks.
It slowly approaches you.
It draws power from the ground.

lines.zh: 铁链一收，你已经在我面前。
lines.en: One pull of the chain and you're before me.
It locks onto your position.

lines.zh: 它的目光变得更为锐利。
lines.en: Its gaze becomes sharper.
You feel its presence.
Its arms extend forward.
It prepares to attack.
It lets out a warning growl.

lines.zh: 它的身形变得更为庞大。
lines.en: Its form grows larger.
Its anger grows stronger.
It opens its arms to you.

lines.zh: 你跑得再快也快不过我。
lines.en: You cannot outrun me.
My iron claws have dug into the floor.
The pull is gathering in my hands.
You stepped into my circle of rust.
This iron shell has claimed you.
My joints are heating up.
Prey, do not waste my time.
I rise, dragging my chains.
You will be sent flying far.
It pulls you to its face.

lines.zh: 它的力量让你感到震颤。
lines.en: Its strength makes you tremble.
Its voice is like thunder.
It pushes you back.
Its power rips you apart.
Its claws grip you tightly.

lines.zh: 这块岩石，是专门给你的。
lines.en: This boulder was picked out for you.

lines.zh: 它的力量让你感到恐惧。
lines.en: Its strength terrifies you.
Its roar suffocates you.
Come here. Do not make me chase.
When I pull, I pull to kill.
Your backward step does nothing.
After the blow, you will fly far.
The muscle under my plates has tightened.
The ground splits under my feet.
Your armor is thin as paper.
I treat this as an execution.
Five hundred years of iron comes down.

lines.zh: 你已经被我的影子压住。
lines.en: My shadow already holds you down.

lines.zh: 嘶嘶声中，毁灭者挥舞着巨大的钳子。
lines.en: A hiss and the Wreck swings its giant claws.

lines.zh: 你的力量在我面前不堪一击。
lines.en: Your strength is nothing against me.
Feel the power of destruction.
You are close to destruction.
My claws can crush you.
Duck, but you cannot escape.
Power peaks here.
Reeled in — you're far too close.
Taste the bitterness of death.

lines.zh: 我的存在证明了你的无力。
lines.en: My presence proves your powerlessness.
One iron sweep and you are airborne!
This blow shakes the ground itself!
Pulled in, then crushed!
Rust and your blood smell the same.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，光芒乍现，毁灭者现身。
lines.en: A burst of light and the Wreck appears.

lines.zh: 黑暗即将降临，你们都将灭亡。
lines.en: Darkness will fall and you will all die.

lines.zh: 欢迎来到毁灭者的领地。
lines.en: Welcome to the Wreck's domain.
This is my domain, get out!

lines.zh: 你们的哀嚎将成为我的盛宴。
lines.en: Your screams will be my feast.

lines.zh: 我在这里守护着古老的秘密。
lines.en: I guard ancient secrets here.
Darkness devours all, fear me.

lines.zh: 我的存在，就是对你们的警告。
lines.en: My presence is a warning to you.
Do not challenge me.
I am the end of all things.
The rust smell comes first; I follow.

lines.zh: 沉重的脚步声从地下传来。
lines.en: Heavy footsteps rise from below.
My armor breaks through the stone wall.
Five thousand years of waiting end.
The floor cracks and iron claws reach out.
Another one comes to die.
I wind the chains around my wrists.
I stand, and gravel falls away.
The rumbling you hear is me.
Deep in the ruins, iron eyes open.
Fire... burning me...

lines.zh: 从高处落下...摔断了我的腿...
lines.en: Fell from a height... broke my leg...
Water... drowning my heart...

lines.zh: 冲击波...撕裂了我的肉体...
lines.en: Explosion... tore my flesh...
Arrow... pierced my chest...
Magic... tore my soul...
Starvation... took my life...
Lightning... struck my heart...
Void... devoured me...
